'''Fritz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in and around the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. He frequently stole items from his clients' cargoes, and he also looked down on most of them. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he visited [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]] and, as was customary in the [[City/Legends|city]], wore an ornate mask while there. He frequented the [[Grande Game]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] and, while wearing his mask, he mocked many of the clients he had worked for; for this, he was unpopular among the locals.

Fritz had a thick accent when speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].
